name: av_unc_rhs_form_not_a_declaration
source:
{ `expr = UncertaintyOf(X)` is recognised by the LEFT-hand side only, so this
  is an ordinary equation (a query), not a declaration. }
x = 3
UncertaintyOf(x) = 0.2
0.6 = UncertaintyOf(y)
y = x^2

error.message: There are 3 equations and 2 variables. The problem is overspecified and cannot be solved. Redundant relation (no free variable left to determine): y=x^2. A common cause: the same physics stated twice — a boundary pinning a quantity a component already defines (a re-equated mixer pressure, a T-pinned wall state), or two property calls restating one relation.
